title: Pan-Seared Cod with Irish Influence
description: A hearty dish combining the flavors of Ireland with the freshness of cod, all in a wicked skillet.
instructions: 1. Heat 1 tablespoon of Irish butter in a wicked skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season the cod fillets with salt and black pepper.
3. Add the cod to the skillet, skin side up, and cook for 2-3 minutes.
4. Flip the cod over and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. In a separate pan, melt the remaining 1 tablespoon of Irish butter over medium heat.
6. Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
7. Sprinkle the flour over the garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
8. Gradually add in 1 cup of water, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
9. Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, until thickened.
10. Serve the cod with the garlic sauce spooned over the top and garnished with chopped parsley.
